answer: Mutual-pagerank edge weighting. Each agent's influence equals its inbound edge share from already-trusted regions; new identities start at zero reach and gain score only when independent clusters route tasks through them. A sybil must first embed a spiral of many low-score nodes into genuine client paths, and every fraudulent edge dilutes its own cluster's score by dividing weight among siblings.
